publication_and_artifact_verification.smoke_scope: The 12000-frame budget lets asynchronous HD validation finish before capture. Private settings/profile preserve the player configuration; the existing HD cache is reused.
limitations: Native Linux AppImage runtime verification is supplied by the native release runner and publisher.
Local Windows verification is static; native launcher and QUIC checks run in Windows CI.
Mac HD smoke uses private settings and supplied local originals; physical audio/input latency is not claimed.

steps.name: Verify all artifacts and publish release
Fetch locked workspace dependencies for offline license metadata
Run cargo run --locked -p bomberman-net --example replay_digest > build/replay-digest.txt
Run sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y pkg-config libudev-dev libasound2-dev libx11-dev libxi-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libgtk-3-dev libarchive-tools librsvg2-common squashfs-tools
Run cargo run --locked -p bomberman-net --example replay_digest > build/replay-digest.txt
Native amd64 relay package and QUIC gameplay

network_scope: Full local 2/10/40-client three-repetition gate, one predeployment ten-client WAN run, and fresh deployed 2/10-client WAN runs; strict latency and native mixed HD/Classic sessions also passed.
limitations: WAN clients and native graphics checks ran on one Apple Silicon Mac; no physical Windows/Linux cross-platform gameplay or physical input/audio latency is claimed.
Each deployed WAN room size has one full repetition; the local 2/10/40-client release gate has three repetitions each.
Later evidence-only commits do not replace the source commit of the published binaries.
